root_cause: The radar checked only the HTTP and top-level status of DataForSEO. A task-level error (40101 Internal SE Server Error) returned empty items and the run reported ok:true with 0 results, hiding that no search had happened.
prevention: Task-level status_code is checked and failures raise an error listed in the run response, with one retry
Run response exposes tavily_raw next to the fresh counts so empty results can be diagnosed

evidence.production_run: 2026-10-27 request 14295: stored 0, providers dataforseo_news 0, errors empty while DataForSEO returned 40101
